summary: human_to_bytes parameters: required input string, default_unit when none is given, and isbits to force bit or byte interpretation.
questions: How do I convert a number without a unit using human_to_bytes?
How do I force human_to_bytes to interpret input as bits?

answer_card.title: human_to_bytes parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (string, required)
- `default_unit` (`Y` ... `K`, `B`): unit to assume when the input has none
- `isbits`: `true` forces bits, `false` forces bytes; unset guesses from the notation
